Commentary.Commentary: Sikandar Raza was terrific with the new ball and came back in the middle overs to keep the pressure on the home side. He finished with career-best figures of 10-1-21-3. Cremer and Williams were tidy as well. The tourists kept on chipping away at the wickets but it was in the slog overs that they lost the plot somewhat. The wicket is turning square and it will be a steep task for Zimbabwe. Asela Gunaratne's sturdy half century just might prove to be the difference between the two sides. Join us in a while for the chase.

A flourish at the fag end of the innings from Gunaratne has taken Sri Lanka past the 200 run-mark which is a very good total on this track. At one stage it seemed that they will get bowled out under 150 but he shepherded the tail and stitched a couple of vital partnerships. The way the hosts started was all gloomy and Zimbabwe were running away with the show. However, a resilient Gunathilaka kept on battling for his side. He scored a patient fifty. The Sri Lankan skipper, Mathews looked jittery in the middle. Both of them were lucky at times but it didn't cost that much to the visitors.

Very full down the leg side, Chameera walks across and tries to paddle it but misses and they run through for a bye. Moor has a shy at the striker's end but misses. The umpire for some reason does not signal a wide. This bye also brings up the fifty run partnership between the two. This could prove to be vital runs for the home side. SRI LANKA FINISH WITH 203/8.
Slower ball outside off, Gunaratne tries to pull it but misses and it goes off his pads towards third man for a run. This is a good comeback by Chatara after going for 8 off the first 2 balls.
A high full toss on leg stump, Asela comes down the track and drives it back to the bowler. He looks at the umpire for a no ball but it is fine.
Low full toss on off, Gunaratne drives it straight to mid off.
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries. 200 up for Lanka. Full and on off, Gunaratne makes room and hits it over point for a boundary.
FOUR! Great start to the over! Short and wide outside off, Asela cuts it over point for a boundary. Poor line there with the off side field up.
Slower short ball on middle, Gunaratne pulls it down to fine leg for a run.

FOUR! WHAT A SHOT! He brings his fifty up in style. Low full toss on leg stump, Asela reverse hits it over the off side for a boundary. He has played really well and helped his team get to a good total here.
The batsman works it down the leg side. They pick up a single.

FOUR! Sloppy from Waller! A low full toss on leg stump, Chameera flicks it through mid-wicket. Waller runs to his left in the deep and dives and makes a meal out of it to concede a boundary. Handy runs for Sri Lanka here.

OUT! What a catch! That is just brilliant from Musakanda. He takes an absolute blinder. Zimbabwe have been superb in the field today and they continue to do so. A short ball outside off, Dananjaya cuts it uppishly towards point. Tarisai Musakanda dives full length to his right and plucks it with one hand. Akila can't believe it. He walks back with a dejected look on his face. The visitors would now want to wrap it up quickly.

Flatter outside off, the batsman plays it towards point for a run. There is a direct hit at the striker's end but no harm done.
Full outside off, Dananjaya drives it through covers for a run.

Flighted ball outside off, turning in. Dananjaya plays it towards mid-wicket. Cremer finishes off with 10-1-23-2.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Floats it on middle, Gunaratne tucks it through mid-wicket for a run.
Tosses it up outside off, Asela lets it through to the keeper.
Flicks it with the spin in front of square leg for a run.

Slider on middle, Dananjaya gets it off the inner half towards mid-wicket. He wants a run but is sent back by his partner.

Not out! Flatter on middle, Asela flicks it towards mid-wicket and sets off for a run. The fielder is quick to reach the ball and throws it to the striker's end. The keeper is quick to take the bails off as well. They appeal and the umpire goes upstairs. Replays show the dive has saved Dananjaya. One run added.

BEATEN! Tossed up on off, Akila tries to defend it off the front foot but gets beaten by the away turn.

He tries to drive it down the ground but is beaten and the ball sneaks between bat and pad and hits the top of off. The crowd here has gone silent. Seven down for Sri Lanka.

Time for Drinks. Zimbabwe have been right on the money on a track which is turning and gripping a lot. Sri Lanka have tried hard to counter the tight bowling but have been found wanting. However, it is still important for the visitors to bowl the hosts out as soon as possible. Anything around 150 will be dicey to chase on this track.
Strides forward to a fullish delivery and eases it to long off for a run.
FOUR! Handy boundary! A bit short outside off, Kulasekara dabs it neatly past short third man. The fielder sprints after it but only manages to come second best.

He camps back and whips it towards mid-wicket but doesn't bother keeping it down. Graeme Cremer stationed there dives to his left to pluck it out of thin air. A sharp catch from him. He is absolutely ecstatic! Sri Lanka continue to lose wickets in quick succession.

The batsman has played it towards mid-wicket. The batsmen have run through for a single.

The ball stays low and goes past his defense to ping him on the front pad. Williams and Moor appeal confidently and the umpire rules it out. Four Byes! That missed the leg stump by a whisker! Floated on leg stump, Danushka shuffles across and looks to sweep it but misses. Luckily, the ball turns down and beats the keeper. Goes across to the fine leg fence. Four byes signaled by the umpire.

7th ODI fifty for Danushka Gunathilaka.
Floated on off, Gunathilaka eases it to long off for a run. It has been a composed and fighting knock from him. Needs to carry on.
Floated outside off, dabbed to short third man for a run.

Floated outside off, eased to long off for a single.
Stays back and defends this one.
The batsman works it down the leg side. One run added to the total.

Two leg byes! Floated outside off, Danushka looks to defend but is struck on the pads and the ball rolls to third man. There is an appeal for an LBW but the umpire shakes his head. The impact was outside off. Two leg byes taken.

Flatter on middle, worked through square leg for a run.
Floated outside off, Gunathilaka looks to defend it but is hit on the pads. The umpire is not interested in the appeal. The impact was outside off.
Short outside off, cut towards point where the fielder dives to his left to make a good save.
The batsman has played it to the point region.

Another shout for an LBW turned down! Tossed up outside off, turns in to beat Gunaratne's defense and hits the pads. The visitors are confident but the umpire stays put. The replays show that he was struck above the knee roll which might have saved him.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Zimbabwe have been terrific in the field today. Tossed up outside off, drilled towards extra cover where the fielder dives to his right to make a brilliant stop.
Floated on off, defended solidly off the back foot.
Sikandar Raza comes back into the attack. He was outstanding in his first spell. Can he continue the good work?
Flatter in line of the stumps, punched through wide mid on for a single.
Loopy ball outside off, stroked to long off for a run.
Straying on the pads, worked through mid-wicket for a run.
Floated outside off, eased through covers for a single.
The batsman works it down the leg side. They pick up a single.
Tossed up around leg stump, Danushka looks to clip but the ball brushes his pads and goes to leg slip.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.

A big shout for an LBW denied! That looked quite adjacent to the naked eye but unfortunately, the visitors do not have a review left. Bowls this one on leg stump and gets it to straighten a bit. Gunathilaka shuffles and looks to play it across but is pinged on the front pad and rolls to short fine leg. A confident appeal from Cremer but the umpire shakes his head. The Hawk Eye shows that it was hitting the leg stump. Danushka gets a reprieve.

The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.

Slow through the air outside off, Gunaratne milks it to long off for a single.
Gunathilaka plays this towards backward square leg. There is a yes and no situation between the batsmen but eventually they cross over safely.
Floated on off, worked to mid-wicket. Single taken.
Flatter delivery outside off, stroked to long on for a run.
Fullish delivery, Asela turns it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Loopy delivery on off, Danushka presses forward in defense.
A bit short outside off, cut to sweeper cover for a run.
Loopy delivery outside leg, turns away and catches the toe end of Gunaratne's bat on his block.
Tossed up delivery, worked to the leg side.
The ball is turning square! Tosses this one on leg stump and gets it to spin past Asela's hanging bat.
Floated outside off, defended solidly off the front foot.
Flatter and quicker one, Asela turns it through mid-wicket for a run.
Floated on off, Gunaratne shuffles and defends.
That's a ripper! Bowls this one around off and gets it to turn away sharply. Asela pokes at it and is beaten all ends up.
Slow through the air, Danushka eases it past the mid-wicket fielder to long on for a single.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Floated on off, Danushka stays back and keeps it out.
Sean Williams is into the attack.
Played to the point region by the batsman. A wicket and 7 runs from the over.
Flatter on off, pushed off the back foot to covers.
Asela Guanaratne is the new man in.

OUT! Brilliant take, Masakadza! Cremer for a change tosses this one nicely outside off, draws Mathews forward. He prods forward to defend but is foxed by the away turn. It catches the outside edge of his bat and goes low towards Hamilton at first slip. He is alert at that position and dives low to his right to take a gem of a catch. This is another massive breakthrough for Zimbabwe. They keep on chipping away at the wickets.
FOUR! Shot! Tossed up on middle, Mathews shimmies down the wicket a touch and drills it past the mid on region to find the fence.
Shortish delivery outside off, Gunathilaka cuts it through point for a run.

Two Leg byes! Down the leg side, Gunathilaka looks to pull it but the ball brushes his pads and goes past the keeper. The fielder in the deep covers a lot of ground to his left and keeps it down to two leg byes.
Fullish delivery outside off, pushed off the front foot to the off side.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Full length delivery on off, patted to extra cover.
Fuller in length around off, Danushka is opened up a touch and gets it off the outer half to third man. A run taken.
Shortish delivery on off, Gunathilaka goes for the pull but is hit near the box area. He is in some pain, that surely stings.
FOUR! Deft! Back of a length delivery outside off, Gunathilaka waits for it and dabs it with an open face to third man. The fielder in the deep runs to his right and dives but fails to stop it.
Tossed up outside off, Mathews drives it crisply towards Cremer who dives to his left and makes a good stop. Zimbabwe have been really good in the field, the energy is right up there.
Works this one through mid-wicket and takes a couple. He needs to take care of his hamstring, can't afford to overstretch it.
A bit slower on off, Mathews defends it stoutly.
Floated around off, pushed off the front foot to short cover.

Confusion but no harm done! Lands it in line of the stumps, Mathews drives it towards Cremer. He fails to stop it cleanly and the ball rolls past him. The mid on fielder runs to his left and attacks the ball. Angelo wanted a run but was rightly sent back by his partner.
Fullish delivery on middle, Danushka eases it past the mid-wicket fielder for a single.
Fractionally overpitched around off, driven on the up to mid off.
On a driving length and in the corridor of uncertainty, Mathews resists the temptation to play an expansive stroke.
Fuller length ball on off, Angelo defends it beside the pitch on the leg side. Thinks about a single but eventually decides against it.

FOUR! Mpofu searches for the yorker but ends up bowling a low full toss on the pads, Mathews just tickles it past the keeper and the ball rolls to the fine leg fence. They need to keep the scoreboard ticking.
Similar length ball on off, Mathews hangs back and defends it nicely.
There is some movement near the sightscreen and Mathews stops the bowler in his delivery stride.
Good length delivery on off, Mathews hops and tucks it beside the pitch on the leg side.
Quicker delivery pushed across the southpaw. He goes for the cut but gets beaten for pace.
Around the pads this time, turned around the corner.
Stays back to this one and defends it solidly to the leg side.
Danushka looks to paddle this one but is early into his shot. Ends up playing it uppishly to mid-wicket but well in front of the fielder.
Fullish delivery outside off, Mathews strokes it to long off for a run.
Floated outside off, pushed with an open face to cover-point for an easy single.
Straying on the hips, helped on its way to fine leg for a run.
Short delivery in line of the stumps, Angelo pulls it through front of square on the leg side. Single taken.
Slower delivery this time, on middle. The Sri Lankan skipper turns it to mid on.
Full length again and in line of the stumps, Angelo defends it solidly right under his eyes.
Fullish delivery outside off, Angelo presses forward and pats it towards mid off.
FOUR! Short delivery outside off, Mathews cuts it past the point fielder for a rocketing boundary. He hit that with a lot of authority.

Time for Drinks. Gunathilaka has been hurt by the dive and needs some medical attention. Zimbabwe have bowled extremely well and bagged three wickets and put the pressure on Sri Lanka. Mathews and Gunathilaka will have to do a rebuilding job for the Lankans if they are to get to a decent total.

NOT OUT! Flighted ball on leg stump, Gunathilaka paddles it through short fine leg. They run the first and then go for the second. There is a throw at the striker's end, Gunathilaka dives and the keeper whips the bails out and appeals. The umpire goes upstairs to check. The replays show he has made it into the crease. Two runs taken.

Tosses it up on off, Angelo flicks it through mid-wicket for a run.

Back of a length on off, Mathews pushes it to covers.
A tad fuller on the stumps, Mathews defends it off the front foot.
Good length outside off, Angelo defends it off the back foot.
Lands it on a length on off, Mathews pushes it to mid off.

Chris Mpofu comes onto bowl.

Flatter delivery around off, Danushka camps back and plays it to cover-point.
Streaky! Tossed up outside off, Mathews prods forward to defend but gets an outside edge past first slip. A run taken.

NOT OUT! Now then what happened there? Length ball outside off, jags back in a little. Mathews tries to play across the line but misses and is struck on the pads. The Zimbabwe players appeal but the umpire shakes his head. Cremer after a chat with his teammates decides to review. It is taken upstairs. The third umpire checks for an inside edge but without the help of Ultra Edge. After looking at it for quite some time he asks the on-field umpire to stick with his decision. We felt there was no inside edge there. The visitors looked quite confident after looking at the first replay. They can't believe that it has not been given. They lose their review.
Zimbabwe have taken a review for an LBW against Mathews. Is there an inside edge? That is the only thing which can save him.
Slower ball on the pads, Gunathilaka misses the flick and is struck on the pads. The ball rolls towards the leg side and they run a leg bye.

Back of a length on middle, Angelo tucks it to the right of the bowler and sets off for a run. The bowler has a shy at the non-striker's end but misses. Mathews pulls up while finishing the run. Looks in a bit of bother.
Length on off, the batsman tries to nudge it on the leg side but gets a leading edge behind point for a run.
FOUR! Bangs it in short, angles it into the batsman. Gunathilaka pulls it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Floats it on middle, Mathews comes down the track and plays it towards mid-wicket. A maiden for Raza.
Loopy ball outside off, Mathews defends it off the front foot.
The batsman has played it towards mid-wicket.
Quicker and full on off, Mathews tries to sweep it but is struck on the pads. There is an appeal from the keeper but nothing from the umpire. That hit him outside the line.

Plays it with the turn to square leg.

Loopy ball on off, Angelo drives it back to the bowler.
Tosses it up outside off, Mathews comes down the track and defends it.
Angelo Mathews strides out to bat. A leg gully in place for him. A captain's knock is the need of the hour. Can he bail his side out of trouble?

OUT! JAFFA! That is a dream ball for an off spinner. Gives it air on middle and leg, the ball turns away sharply. Tharanga tries to defend it off the front foot but gets beaten and the ball knocks the top of off. Tharanga can't believe it but he has to walk back. Zimbabwe are on top here.
Shorter outside off, Gunathilaka punches it through extra cover for a run.
Lands it on a length outside off, Tharanga shoulders his arms to it.
Short and wide outside off, the ball stays a touch low. Tharanga tries to pull it but misses.
Very wide outside off, Tharanga lets it through to the keeper.
FOUR! CRUNCHED! Shorter in length on middle, Tharanga camps back and pulls it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Slower ball on middle, Tharanga flicks it to mid-wicket.
WIDE! Short and wide outside off, Upul slashes at it but gets beaten and the umpire signals a wide.
Fullish and wide outside off, Tharanga drives it to covers.
Was there an edge? A bit flatter on off, turns away from the batsman. He tries to cut it but gets beaten. Replays show there was no edge there.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
A tad short outside off, Danushka cuts it to point.
Full on the stumps, the batsman drives it to mid on.
Floats it on middle, does not turn a lot. Gunathilaka defends it off the front foot.
Tosses it up on off, Tharanga drives it down to long off for a run.
Just ahead of a length outside off, Gunathilaka does not bother to play a shot at it.
Good length outside off, Gunathilaka points his bat skywards and lets it through.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
FOUR! TOP SHOT! A tad fuller outside off, Gunathilaka drives it through covers and the ball races to the fence. Two boundaries in the over now.
Lands it on a length on off, the batsman gets it off the inner half towards the leg side.
FOUR! EASY PICKINGS! Drifts it on the pads, Gunathilaka flicks it to fine leg for a boundary.
Flighted ball on middle, Gunathilaka drives it off the toe end to the left of Raza for a run.
WIDE! Sprays it down the leg side and Gunathilaka misses his flick and the umpire signals a wide.
Floats it up on off, turns away. Draws Gunathilaka forward who gets beaten on the outside edge.
Loopy ball on middle, Gunathilaka drives it back to the bowler.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Full ball outside off, Tharanga drives it through extra cover for a run.
Upul Tharanga comes out to bat. A slip in place. Sri Lanka are in a bit of bother.

OUT! The ploy to start with a spinner pays off. Raza strikes. Mendis is walking back to the hut. A big blow for Sri Lanka and they are in a spot of bother here. Tosses it up on middle, Mendis comes down the track and flicks it straight to Cremer at short mid-wicket. The Zimbabwe players are over the moon. Sri Lanka have lost their second.
FOUR! Bangs it on a back of a length on off, Gunathilaka gets it off the splice of the bat down to third man for a boundary. He played that well, took one hand off the bat to keep the ball down.
WIDE! Bouncer on middle, the ball bounces way above the head of the batsman and the umpire signals a wide.
Just ahead of a length outside off, swings in a little. Gunathilaka lets it through to the keeper.
Good length on off, Gunathilaka defends it off the front foot.
Bangs it short on off, the batsman ducks under it.
Fullish length on off, Mendis drives it towards mid on for a run. The fielder does well to run to his left and stop the ball.
Angles it into the pads, Gunathilaka flicks it to fine leg for a run.
Plays it with the spin on the leg side.
Floats it on middle, Mendis works it on the leg side.
Drags his length back a little on off, Gunathilaka pushes it down the ground to long off for a run.

Some spin there for Raza! Tosses it up outside off, turns away from the batsman. Gunathilaka tries to defend it off the front foot but is beaten. There is appeal from the keeper but nothing from the umpire.
Brilliant stop, Cremer! Tossed up outside off, driven towards short extra cover where the skipper dives to his right to save some runs for his side.

A tad short outside off, Gunathilaka punches it down towards wide long off. They run one and go for a second. Gunathilaka is running the second one slow and then realises that the throw is coming to his end and then quickens his speed to make it in.
Lands it on a length on off, Kusal defends it off the front foot. A successful first over for Chatara. A maiden wicket.
Good length outside off, Mendis shoulders his arms to it.
Wide enough for the batsman to not play at it.
A tad fuller on off, Mendis drives it to mid off.
Kusal Mendis walks in at No. 3.

OUT! Chatara strikes! The man in form Dickwella has to depart. After stitching two double century opening stands in a row with Gunathilaka, the wicketkeeper batsman has a failure to his name. It is a huge wicket for Zimbabwe. An early strike, just what they wanted after opting to bowl first. Back of a length ball on off, straightens a little, Dickwella pokes at it and gets an outside edge to the keeper, Peter Moor who makes no mistake. The Zimbabwe players are ecstatic. Sri Lanka lose their first.
Straightaway, Dickwella makes room. Chatara follows him and the batsman chops it on the bounce to the keeper.
Tendai Chatara to bowl with the second new ball from the other end. A slip in place.
Dances down the track and drives it to long off for a run. A good first over by Raza.
Flighted ball on middle, Dickwella gets a leading edge on the bounce to the bowler.

Loopy ball on off, Dickwella pushes it towards covers. Gunathilaka wants a run but is sent back by his partner. The fielder makes it quick to the ball and has a shy at the bowler's end but misses. No damage done.
Slower through the air on off, Niroshan defends it off the front foot.
Floats it outside off, the batsman drives it to covers.
Starts off with a tossed up ball outside off, Dickwella drives it through extra cover for a couple.
We are ready to get underway. Niroshan Dickwella and Danushka Gunathilaka to open the batting for Sri Lanka. Zimbabwe to begin with Sikandar Raza. Here we go...

Toss - Graeme Cremer is a happy man at the moment. He has won the toss finally after losing eight in a row. As expected, he opts to field. They are unchanged while there are two changes for Sri Lanka. NUWAN KULASEKARA and AKILA DANANJAYA come in for Asitha Fernando and Lakshan Sandakan.

PITCH REPORT - Alistair Campbell and Russel Arnold say that they are back to a used pitch. Mentions there are a few cracks but it is going to be full of runs. Opines the captain winning the toss will want to bowl first. Reckons there is not a lot of wind blowing which should help the bowlers execute their plans better.

Sri Lanka on the other hand have been prolific with the bat as their top order has been in supreme form. However, it is their bowling which has let them down. Their go-to man, Malinga has been toothless and that has deflated their morale. Bringing back Kulasekera into the mix might provide them some stability. A well-rounded performance is the need of the hour for them. Can the Lankan Lions bounce back to clinch the series or will Zimbabwe reign supreme in the decider? Expect the team winning the toss to bowl as all the four games till now have been won chasing.

Hello and a warm welcome for the 5th and final ODI between Sri Lanka and Zimbabwe in Hambantota. It has been a cracker of a series so far and the winner today will take it all. Contrary to expectations, the visitors have taken their game to a new level all together. Who would have expected them to be on equal terms at present before this tour started. It has been a team effort for them with different players chipping in at crunch situations. Graeme Cremer is leading from the front and if his side emerges victorious today, it would be their first bilateral series win over a a Test-playing nation away from home, since they beat Bangladesh in Bangladesh in 2001.
